description: This file contains functional tests for the Basket/Index page of an eShop web application. It uses xUnit for testing and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing to perform HTTP client requests to test adding and updating basket items.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the functionality of updating basket items including changing quantity and emptying the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Test that updates a basket item quantity to 50 and verifies the total amount.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Test that updates a basket item quantity to 0, which empties the basket, and verifies the 'Basket is empty' message.
